requirements.definition: X shall be real, and Y shall have the same type and kind type parameter as X.

requirements.title: IEEE_MIN_MAG returns the minimum-magnitude operand or IEEE_MIN tie result
requirements.definition: The result is X for |X|<|Y|, Y for |Y|<|X|, and otherwise the IEEE_MIN(X,Y) value.

pending.IEEE_MIN_MAG-X-smaller-magnitude: Guarded plan probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X); datatype-supported branch uses X=1.5 and Y=-2.5, initializes result to -9.0, and asserts result==1.5; unsupported branch skips. Mutate argument order or expected value so the magnitude choice is load-bearing.
pending.IEEE_MIN_MAG-Y-smaller-magnitude: Guarded plan probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X); datatype-supported branch uses X=-3.0 and Y=2.0, initializes result to 9.0, and asserts result==2.0; unsupported branch skips. Mutate Y to 4.0 so the selected operand changes.
pending.IEEE_MIN_MAG-equal-magnitude-delegates-t: Guarded plan probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X) for IEEE_MIN_MAG and IEEE_MIN; datatype-supported branch uses X=-2.0 and Y=2.0, asserts result equals IEEE_MIN(X,Y) and equals -2.0 for this finite tie; unsupported branch skips. Mutate X to -1.0 so the tie path is not reached.
